text:
Leah: Quick sync for the upcoming webinar 10 days out. Need to lock final runorder + who owns demo fallback and the social/landing assets. Reply with short ack or the one thing you own.

Ava: I'll own slides + 1-page benchmark graphic. Deliverable: two variants (deck and promo). Need numbers from Priya by EOD Fri.

Priya: Will hand off benchmark numbers and a repeatable 50-token demo prompt. Also recommend 15/25/20 split to maximize demo time.

Ravi: I can own demo failover. Plan: primary Dedicated, fallback to Hosted quantized, final fallback EU warm-cache. I'll build a small toggle and a one-line scrub step.

Ethan: I'll moderate and handle live Q->SDR routing. Suggest a 2-min poll after keynote (PoC/Scale/Security) so we can tag intent. Also propose "request demo" CTA map to SDR queues by ARR band.

Ops: Confirm we can map Zoom regs to SFDC campaign "webinar-apr-07" and tag fields: interest_level, demo_click, arr_band. Will create two SDR queues (ARR>100k). Recording retention default 90 days.

Oliver: I can join panel, will upload slides Wed noon. Need consent form for recording.

Leah: Draft runorder (60m):
0:00-0:02 Housekeeping (Leah)
0:02-0:17 Keynote (Sarah)
0:17-0:42 Live demo (Miguel + Ravi)
0:42-0:56 Panel (Oliver, Sarah, Miguel)
0:56-1:00 Close + CTA (Leah + Ethan)

Ava: Rehearsals: tech check 30m (2 days prior), full dress 60m (1 day prior), final mic check 15m (1h prior). I'll send invites.

Leah: Actions: Ava get design + chase slides (Mon EOD); Priya demo prompt + numbers (Fri); Ravi toggle + scrub (Wed); Ops mapping (Tue); Speakers sign consent + upload slides (Wed noon).

Priya: ack 1 will post benchmark doc to #marketing-assets.

Ravi: ack 1 pushing toggle to /rehearsals/demo-fallbacks and will ping when ready.

Ava: ack 1 design looping in now.

Leah: Thanks 1 calendar invites incoming.

ZoomBot: Recording scheduled for 2026-04-07 10:00 PT. Link: https://zoom.us/rec/def456 (org access only).
